title: Mitochondrion Power Plant

serves.summary: The learner runs a mitochondrion as a power plant, moving protons across the membrane so the gradient turns the turbine and charges ATP, which shows how a mitochondrion makes energy for the cell.

request.objective: Mitochondria decomposes into a containment structure (matrix, membrane, intermembrane space), a process (four ordered steps), and a causal mechanism (gradient drives the turbine), plus known misconceptions.

problems.goal: 3 protons have run through the turbine, charging 3 batteries.

problems.ask: Charge all 5 ATP batteries. This mitochondrion is not working properly.
problems.goal: The hole is patched and 5 protons have run through the turbine.

problems.ask: Charge all 5 ATP batteries. There are only a few protons in the matrix.
problems.goal: Protons pumped and run through the turbine again until 5 batteries are charged.
6 protons have run through the turbine, charging 2 batteries.
